strip.title: How many hours is your team losing?
strip.description: Four short questions, your own figures. You see the estimate straight away, no email needed.

modal.title: How many hours is your team losing?

people.label: How many people do repetitive admin work?
people.help: Everyone who spends part of a normal week on manual, repeating tasks.
people.error: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}

hours.label: How many hours a week does each of them spend on it?
hours.help: An average is fine. Think of an ordinary week, not your busiest one.
hours.error: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}

cost.label: What does an hour of their time cost you?
cost.help: Gross cost to the company per hour, not take-home pay. Change it if {{default}} is not right for your team.
cost.error: Enter a whole amount between {{min}} and {{max}}

tasks.label: Which tasks does that work involve?
tasks.help: Pick everything that applies. This shapes the breakdown report; it does not change the numbers.

result.title: Here is what that time is worth
result.estimateNote: This is an estimate based on the figures you entered and the assumptions below. It is not a measurement of your business.
result.assumptionInputs: Your figures: {{people}} people × {{hours}} hours a week × {{cost}} an hour. The hourly cost is your own figure.
result.assumptionWeeks: {{weeks}} working weeks a year, allowing for holidays and public holidays.
result.assumptionRange: The {{low}}% to {{high}}% range is Impera's own estimate, not a measured figure. Where a business lands inside it depends on its tools, its data and how consistent the process already is.

email.title: Want the breakdown?
email.description: We will email you a short report, written around the tasks you picked:
email.bullet1: Your tasks ranked by how well they automate
email.bullet2: What we would automate first, and why
email.bullet3: What is probably not worth automating
email.label: Work email
email.consent: Impera may email me a confirmation link and then this report. See the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
email.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
email.consentRequired: Please tick the box so we may send you the report.
email.error: We could not send that. Please try again.

done.title: Check your inbox
done.description: We sent you an email. Open it and press the button to confirm, and the report follows right away. Check your spam folder if you do not see it within a few minutes.
done.auditText: Want to go through the numbers with us?

confirmEmail.subject: Confirm your email to get your report
confirmEmail.intro: You asked for the breakdown behind your hours-lost estimate. Press the button to confirm this is your address and we will send the report straight away.
confirmEmail.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Nothing will be sent and we will not email you again.

confirmPage.title: Get your report
confirmPage.description: Press the button to confirm your email address. We will send your breakdown report right away.
confirmPage.sent: Done. Your report is on its way, it should reach you within a few minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not.
confirmPage.alreadySent: This report was already sent to you. Check your inbox and spam folder.
confirmPage.invalid: This link is not valid. Please use the link from the latest email, or start again from the calculator.
confirmPage.expired: This link has expired. Please run the calculator again to get a new one.
confirmPage.busy: Your report is being sent. Please wait a moment and check your inbox.
confirmPage.error: We could not send the report. Please try again.

report.subject: Your estimate: {{hours}} hours a year lost to repetitive admin
report.intro: Here is the breakdown behind your estimate, based on the figures you entered.
report.inputsLine: {{people}} people × {{hours}} hours a week × {{cost}} an hour
report.range: Realistically automatable (estimate): {{hours}} hours and {{cost}} a year
report.rankedTitle: Your tasks, ranked by automation fit

why.dataEntry: Copying between systems is the classic automation case.
why.followUps: Templating works, but tone and timing need human review.
why.reporting: Data gathering automates well, interpretation does not.
why.quotes: Depends on how standardised the pricing is.

report.automateFirstNone: None of your selected tasks is a clear first candidate. A short audit would show where to start.
report.notWorthItReason: At about {{hours}} h a week, there is little to gain yet.
report.notWorthItNone: Nothing on your list falls below that line.
report.assumptionEvenSplit: Your stated hours are split evenly across the tasks you selected. We do not know your real split.
report.assumptionFit: Automation fit is Impera's own judgement, not a measured figure.
report.disclaimer: This is an estimate, not a quote or a promise of savings.
report.auditText: Want to check these numbers against your real processes?
